campaign.name: Geometric-efficiency record attempt (2D-local, w<=8, d<=40 tier)
campaign.hypothesis: The geometric-efficiency record (1.7555, [[957,105,4]], w=4 d=4 exact-certified, static since 2026-10-06) lives in the sparsely contested geo track (~2.6% of board records carry geo >= 1.0). Dense hole-pattern layouts at n 700-1000 with exact-certifiable d (SAT ladder) can beat it. Barrier to entry is a verifier-accepted layout (rho, r) plus honest d -- the derating engine cannot easily attack a proven point.

bar.note: record holder; beat requires geo > 1.7555 with layout + certified d

campaign.method: local_sat.py / sat_rungs.py (cadical195) over dense-packing layouts derived from the L6 boundary_engine experience; sat_certify.py ladder mode for d_lower certificates; layout must pass the verifier's locality checks
campaign.what_a_negative_would_teach: Whether 1.7555 is a structural ceiling for single-layer 2D-local layouts at this tier or just an unchallenged incumbent.
